sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A perennial carnivorous plant of wet tepuis in Venezuela, Guyana and northern Brazil, at about 1,200–2,800 m. Its pitchers are about 20–30 cm long and open to 8–10 cm across.

sections.title: Flowers and traps
sections.text: A 40–45 cm stalk bears drooping white flowers with petals 3–5 cm long. The pitchers trap insects; digestive enzyme production is not confirmed in the horticultural reference consulted.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use is documented; this carnivorous plant is not intended for consumption.
